claim: The new type synonym (and hence the whole namespace) is named `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing`, whereas the only precedent in the library for this construction — the abbreviation this PR is designed to replace — spells the ring category out in full as `PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat` (Pushforward.lean:71). The `CommRingCat` name is also what every binder in this file uses (`R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}`), so the shortened `OfCommRing` suffix is inconsistent.
requested_change: Rename `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing` to `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRingCat` (and the file `OfCommRing.lean` to `OfCommRingCat.lean`, the namespace, and the `Mathlib.lean` import name accordingly) so it matches `PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat`; if instead the intent is to retire the `...OfCommRingCat` spelling, say so in the PR description.

claim: `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀` is definitionally the same functor as the pre-existing public abbreviation `PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat` (Pushforward.lean:71), so this PR leaves two public names for one functor — exactly the duplication the namespace was introduced to remove. I verified the two are equal by `rfl`: `(PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀ F R : _ ⥤ _) = (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat F R : _ ⥤ _)`.
requested_change: Add `@[deprecated PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀ (since := "...")]` (or an `alias`/deprecation) to `PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat` in `Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/Pushforward.lean`, and update the single use in `Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/PushforwardZeroMonoidal.lean` (`(pushforward₀OfCommRingCat F R).Monoidal`) to the new name, so that only `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀` remains canonical.
